summary.text: Bud Hulsey is a Republican state representative from Kingsport representing Tennessee House District 2 (part of Sullivan County), a member of the 109th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Appropriations and Oversight Subcommittee and co-chairs the Joint Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hulsey was born on May 30, 1949, and is a retired police lieutenant with a B.A. from Bob Jones University and postgraduate work at the University of Virginia through the FBI National Academy.

Hulsey was appointed to the Tennessee Peace Officer Standards and Training Commission, on which he served from 2016 to 2024, and to the Tennessee Council for Adult Offender Supervision from 2019 to 2020.
In the House he also serves on the Agriculture & Natural Resources, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Private Acts committees.
